review_notes: Readability cleanup of existing recovered code only; no new native coverage. 40 exact local-token substitutions and 18 structured edits. Preserve hom_clockwork, Gemstone Array, Brightling and get_random_permanent control flow while renaming their locals. Include the private assist helper outside the old inventory. One combined build; no full audits or reccmp refresh.

Lorwyn: preserve attachment and death bookkeeping, Colfenor's Urn selection and graveyard scan order, Dourbark characteristic values and Lignify event routing. Fifth Dawn: simplify Station trigger/activation dispatch and Suncrusher common tails while preserving query order and sunburst calls.

Homelands: preserve Giant Oyster draw-phase versus leave-play cleanup, Baron Sengir regeneration targeting, Orcish Mine ore triggers and cached damage behavior, and Serra Bestiary flag removal. Clockwork handling receives exact local-token substitution only.

Commander 2017: preserve Kindred Discovery attack/ETB routing and Path of Ancestry commander color reads. Replace Kindred Charge exact 151-byte buffer clear with memset and structured scans. Battlebond: simplify Arcane Artisan reverse token cleanup and Last One Standing selection while preserving RNG and empty-battlefield quirks; retain random-permanent network paths unchanged under token substitution.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
